title: Onboarding Visuals Safeguard Pipeline — redaction, smart-cropping, localization-safe outputs
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a repeatable, brand-consistent pipeline to produce onboarding and quickstart screenshots that are redaction-aware, use smart-cropping for responsive surfaces, and produce localization-safe variants. The pipeline must integrate with existing design tokens and the marketing brand kit, generate thumbnails for docs and in-product quickstarts, and output manifests that engineering can consume for automated releases.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Single pipeline produces PNG/JPEG/WEBP variants for US/DE/JP locales with correct localized strings or placeholders. 2) Sensitive state (API keys, emails, account IDs) automatically redacted or replaced with deterministic placeholders. 3) Smart-cropping rules preserve CTA visibility across breakpoints. 4) Output filenames and manifest format match the engineering ingestion spec (seen in ENG-2541). 5) Figma -> automated export proof-of-concept exists and design review approved.
steps: Audit current onboarding screenshots and tag sensitive elements (privacy, PII, internal URLs)
Define redaction rules and placeholder taxonomy in discussion with Security and Legal
Design smart-crop presets for 320/768/1280 width breakpoints with overlay guides
Prototype Figma plugin/export script to mark localized text layers for replacement
Build CI job that runs exports, applies redaction, resizing, and outputs manifest to s3/docs-assets/<release>/
Coordinate with ENG to wire the manifest into the docs pipeline and console asset resolver
